Theorem
[Exponential lower bound for nonflat steadies (Theorem 27.28)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0037, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0038 1. ch27:27.28\group Steady solitons

If a normalized steady GRS has $f\le 0$ and $f\to -\infty $ at infinity, then \[ R\ge \frac{1}{\sqrt{n/2+2}}e^f\ge c e^{-d(x,\widetilde O)}. \]
